notes: AROUSAL — two separate meters. PLAYER: $player.arousal 0..$game.maxArousal (maxArousal=10 confirmed live). NPC: $npc.<Name>.arousal 0..3 (Dad/Brother/Grandpa).

PLAYER arousal raises: <<AddArousal>> = StatsService.addArousal -> increaseArousal(player,maxArousal): arousal=min(arousal+1,maxArousal). +1 per call, cap 10. Skipped in galleryMode (and getArousal() returns 10 in gallery).

PLAYER arousal also +1 PER NEW DAY: TimeService.newDay -> resetPlayerStats: energy=maxEnergy (reset full) BUT if(arousal<maxArousal) addArousal() else arousal=10. So sleep RESETS energy but RAISES arousal +1. No reset-to-0 on sleep.

NPC arousal raises: per-NPC add widgets (e.g. AddBrotherArousal -> increaseArousal(Brother,3)) = +1 cap 3. ALSO +1 PER NEW DAY hardcoded: updateNPCs() does if(Dad/Brother/Grandpa.arousal<3) arousal++.

RESET to 0: player via <<ResetArousal>> (arousal=0) and inside <<FinishSex>> (StatsService.resetArousal). Family NPC reset to 0 at climax: finishSex sets npc.arousal=0 + NpcService.addCorruption(npc) for Dad/Brother/Grandpa. Also ResetDad/Brother/GrandpaArousal widgets.
NO TIME DECAY anywhere. Only arousal decrement in entire JS = drug modifier line (player.arousal=Math.max(0,player.arousal+mods.arousal)). Both meters are no-decay climbers, reset only at climax.

GATES (the two-axis tier system) — family scenes gated corruption x arousal: stage1 corr>=5 && arousal>=1; stage2 corr>=10 && arousal>=2; stage3 corr>=15 && arousal>=3 (galleryMode bypasses). Confirmed in current passage source too: BedroomStudy Dad/Brother grope needs npc.arousal>0 && npc.corruption>0; BedroomSleep Dad scene needs Dad.arousal>0 && Dad.corruption>0.

UI SURFACING — PLAYER: left bar '⚡ Energy & Arousal' card shows band text via getArousalText(level): 0 Calm,1 Warm,2 Aroused,3 Hot,4 Burning; level=arousal==0?0:min(ceil(arousal/max*4),4). Live: arousal 6/10 -> 'Hot'. NPC: right 'House' sidebar per family member row '🔥 Arousal: <sideBarText>' where sideBarText set by updateArousalText: 0 ❄️,1 🔥,2 🔥🔥,3 🔥🔥🔥. Corruption row shows 'MAX' at >=15 (confirmed live).
